versions.changelog:
- No file changes were detected in this release.
- Documentation and guidance remain unchanged; no functional or behavioral updates included.
- Version bump only; this update has no impact on users.

- Initial release of the evm-wallet-clawcast skill for crypto/EVM wallet operations using `cast`.
- Supports wallet creation, key import, balance checks, coin/token transfers, transaction management, and keystore security.
- Includes onboarding scripts for step-by-step wallet setup, network selection, and token configuration.
- Provides readiness checks, wallet/network status display, and safe wallet removal scripts for user convenience.
- Maintains a transaction mention log for reference and guides users to block explorers if API-based lookups are unavailable.
